'''InterWorld Marketplace''' was a shopping center on board the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] that carried items from numerous [[Planet/Legends|planets]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Shopping at the market was tariff-free.<ref name="RPG" />
